1651-6751-6754-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-6751-6754-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-6751-6754-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7841.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

6495-7084-7396.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-7084-7396.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

348-1152-4867-6887-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-6887-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and The Skullspore Nexus triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2724-4006-5900.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Lilysplash Mentor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1978-7013-7329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-7013-7329.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-3845.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

4131-4222-5115-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

687-4929-5641-5684-6296.notablePrerequisites: If Jirina is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Jirina is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-4929-5641-5684-6296.description:
Cast Jirina by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Jirina from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Jirina.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Jirina and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Jirina by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Jirina from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-4929-5641-5684-6296.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-2292-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-2292-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

38-2169-2420.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2169-2420.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

3783-4300-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3783-4300-5686.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Illusion token.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

939-1636-3661-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Shield Sphere exiled by Soul Foundry.
939-1636-3661-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Shield Sphere
When the Shield Sphere token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2102-3814-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
2102-3814-4875.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1414-1492-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1414-1492-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

2034-2082-3197.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2034-2082-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2082-3197.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.

2743-4365-5461.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2743-4365-5461.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

4024-4050-4620.notablePrerequisites:
Captain of the Mists does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Humans.
4024-4050-4620.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Captain of the Mists triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Human Soldiers, adding {4}{U}.
Activate Captain of the Mists by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Humans as the combo begins, this combo nets infintie creature tokens, colored mana, and untap of permanents you control.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-1993-3756.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-1993-3756.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
